column2: Character: a male farmer in his thirties, sun-tanned, short brown beard, straw-coloured wide-brim hat; loose linen shirt with rolled sleeves, brown wool trousers tied at the calf, worn leather boots; a plain cream off-white cloth sash tied at the waist; accent colour moss green on the sleeveless wool jerkin.

Character: a female farmer in her thirties, sturdy and cheerful, auburn hair in a braid under a plain cream off-white headscarf; rust-orange wool kirtle (accent colour) with sleeves rolled up, brown skirt hitched to the shin, leather ankle boots; a plain cream off-white apron over the skirt.

Character: a burly blacksmith in his forties, bald with a thick black beard, very muscular bare forearms; dark grey linen shirt, a heavy brown leather apron from chest to knee, thick leather gloves tucked in the belt, sturdy boots; a plain cream off-white neckerchief; accent colour deep ember red on the shirt cuffs and belt cloth.

Character: a round, friendly miller-baker in his forties, rosy cheeks, ginger moustache, dusted all over with white flour; floppy cream off-white linen baker's cap, mustard yellow wool tunic (accent colour), brown breeches, soft leather shoes; a plain cream off-white apron, flour smudges on the arms.

Character: a market stallholder man in his thirties, lean, curly black hair, cheeky grin; teal blue padded wool doublet (accent colour) over a linen shirt, brown hose, short leather boots, a leather coin purse on the belt; a plain cream off-white short shoulder cape with a hood down on his back.

Character: a townswoman in her twenties, dark hair in a bun, kind face; long plum purple wool dress (accent colour) with laced bodice, a plain cream off-white knitted shawl around the shoulders, brown leather belt, simple shoes.

Character: a prosperous merchant in his fifties, plump, neatly trimmed grey beard, confident smile; rich deep emerald green velvet robe (accent colour) to the shin with gold-thread trim and fur collar, gold chain on the chest, soft leather boots, round felt hat; a plain cream off-white silk sash across the waist.

Character: an elderly man in his seventies, slightly stooped, long white beard, bald crown with white hair at the sides, bushy eyebrows, warm eyes; long faded brown wool robe, a dusty slate blue sleeveless coat (accent colour), worn sandals; a plain cream off-white hood resting on his shoulders.

Character: an elderly woman in her seventies, small and slightly stooped, wrinkled kind face, grey hair under a plain cream off-white wimple-style head cloth; dark brown wool dress, a soft heather lilac knitted shawl (accent colour), simple leather shoes; a plain cream off-white apron.

Character: a boy about ten years old, child proportions (short, big head, skinny limbs), messy sandy hair, freckles, gap-toothed grin; oversized moss-brown wool tunic, patched brown trousers, scuffed little boots; a plain cream off-white cloth belt sash; accent colour bright sky blue on a short hooded capelet.

Character: a girl about ten years old, child proportions (short, big head, slim limbs), two red pigtail braids, freckles, bright smile; a sunflower yellow wool dress (accent colour) to the shin, brown leather shoes; a plain cream off-white pinafore apron over the dress.

Character: a monk-priest in his fifties, tonsured head, clean-shaven, calm serious face; a long heavy dark brown wool habit to the ankles with wide sleeves, a rope belt, sandals; a plain cream off-white scapular hanging down the front from the shoulders; accent colour deep wine red on a small embroidered stole edge.

Character: a noble lady in her thirties, elegant, auburn hair braided up under a slim gold circlet, composed face; a long royal blue brocade gown (accent colour) with long hanging sleeves and gold trim, a jewelled belt, soft slippers; a plain cream off-white veil and a plain cream off-white overdress panel down the front of the gown.

Character: a medieval town crier in his forties, tall, big barrel chest, booming open-mouthed smile, dark bushy beard; a bright scarlet red knee-length wool tunic (accent colour) belted with brown leather, a scarlet hooded chaperon cowl over the shoulders, brown wool hose, tall soft leather boots; a plain cream off-white tabard panel with a dagged hem hanging down the front of the tunic. Plain 14th-century medieval clothing, no buttons, no feathers.
